submission.justification: Mixture-G3 with a 1.5 mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 1.965 ns among all compliant configurations. This is the only mixture that satisfies the mandatory GWP100 ≤ 150 environmental constraint. The 1.5 mm gap was identified as optimal after evaluating 5 different gap widths (1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, and 3.0 mm), with time resolution degrading at both smaller and larger gaps. This configuration meets all requirements while delivering superior detector performance.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Time resolution of 1.965 ns achieved at 1.5 mm gap, which is the best among all 8 configurations evaluated. This represents an improvement over the baseline 2.0 ns at 2.0 mm gap.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 is one of the three candidate mixtures listed in candidate_specs.md
Mixture-G3 is the only eligible mixture meeting the GWP100 ≤ 150 constraint. Mixtures G1 and G2 were found to be ineligible due to exceeding this environmental limit.
Recommended gap of 1.5 mm is well within the 1-3 mm constraint range
